name: Ukima Yuzuki
source: The middle sister who has a very serious and firm personality. She rarely talks to the protagonist at school and acts quite cold towards him, but in reality just wants to be spoiled by him. She often bickers with Mio and is jealous of her for the fact that she is always around the protagonist.
